title: Vault: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116585)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the vault package's Go JOSE implementation, which handles Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 2.2.1-r1. A fix has been released in version 2.2.1-r1. The CVSS 4.0 base score is 6.9, indicating a medium severity issue.
